answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 6450 Country: India Title: I travel to several countries. Today, in lunch, we had asked for a seafood pizza. i was very clear that there should not be any meat (as i am halal conscious). When i had a first or the second bite, i got a piece of salami (pork). i immediately stopped eating the food. I asked for allahs forgiveness and prayed. What should i do. I am feeling extremely bad and guilty. i dont know if i have eaten the salami (port piece). kindly guide. Question: As salaam alaikum. I travel to several countries. Today, in lunch, we had asked for a seafood pizza. i was very clear that there should not be any meat (as i am halal conscious). When i had a first or the second bite, i got a piece of salami (pork). i immediately stopped eating the food. I asked for allahs forgiveness and prayed. What should i do. I am feeling extremely bad and guilty. i dont know if i have eaten the salami (port piece). kindly guide. Answer ID: 6450 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 589/589=M/1429) You were right to immediately discontinue eating the food when you got the piece of pork in your food. The Almighty Allah will reward you for the same. And if unknowingly you have eaten a bite of Haram, then you should ask forgiveness from Almighty Allah and in future avoid eating such food, especially when you are on the trip to Western Countries, do not eat the meat of animals slaughtered of Jews and Christians. You should avoid eating meat in planes and wherever you have a doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
